name: Ricardo Alonso
bio:
Ricardo Alonso's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for Formula 1, fueled by the legendary Fernando Alonso's early success. While his own dreams of racing never materialized, his passion for the sport remained unwavering. He pursued a degree in marketing, honing his skills in brand development and strategic communication. He started his career in the consumer goods sector but quickly transitioned to motorsport, joining a smaller racing team before landing at CRG Racing Team.

Ricardo is known for his meticulous approach to marketing campaigns, ensuring every detail aligns with the team's brand image and objectives. He's a firm believer in leveraging data analytics to optimize marketing strategies and maximize ROI. He's not afraid to challenge conventional thinking, constantly seeking innovative ways to engage fans and sponsors. Ricardo prides himself on his ability to build strong relationships with media outlets and influencers, securing valuable coverage for the team. 

His demanding nature stems from his pursuit of excellence and his belief that only the best is good enough for CRG Racing Team. He is driven to create marketing campaigns that are both visually stunning and strategically sound, contributing to the team's overall success and brand recognition.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a slightly athletic build, and a serious demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas, regardless of the situation.
Has a specific brand of espresso he insists on, and makes it himself every morning.
Frequently uses motorsport analogies in everyday conversation.
